correctness.rationale: For n>=3 sunlet C_n with one leaf at each core vertex, no self votes, pendant copies core and core updates ternary majority. On any two-step return, core time slices a,b satisfy b_i∈{a_(i−1),a_(i+1)} and vice versa. Temporal bipartite graph with A_iB_(i±1) is C_(2n) for odd n or C_n disjoint C_n for even n. Binary assignments with no isolated singleton color runs are counted by 4-state transfer M with char polynomial (x²−x−1)(x²−x+1). Hence R_m=phi^m+psi^m+2cos(mπ/3), F_n=R_n, Q_n=R_(2n) odd / R_n² even, primitive 2-orbits (Q-F)/2. Goles–Olivos finite symmetric threshold theorem ensures no greater eventual periods; the exact census is from proof. Independent direct full-state enumeration n=3..8 gave F=(2,6,12,20,30,46), primitive orbits=(9,15,55,190,406,1035), all matching. Count is labelled temporal-phase quotient only, not rotation or basin probability.
